contact.name: Michael Deunov
contact.evidence_quote: To best explain our unusual story, which began in the summer of 1983, we will first need to examine our founder, Michael Deunov. Michael was a public school educator who was disappointed with the system. He thought, "there must be other ways to raise children, with schools where children are nurtured in nature, where parents, teachers and communities work together to create a harmonious and sustainable environment."
